captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a flat, ring-shaped kendo sword handguard (tsuba) with a rounded outer edge. It features a central circular hole designed to fit over the sword's tang. The outer perimeter is smooth and rounded, while the top and bottom flat faces are designed to accommodate engraved text.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric kendo sword hilt guard (tsuba) with a customizable outer diameter, inner diameter, and thickness. The design must feature a rounded outer edge and support customizable text engraved on the top surface, repeated at four 90-degree rotations.
captions.factory: The script uses a union of two main parts: a flat cylindrical body and a rounded outer rim. The body is created using a difference() operation where a central inner_diameter cylinder is subtracted from an outer cylinder, alongside four writecylinder() calls rotated by 90-degree increments to engrave the custom hilt_text on the top surface. The rounded outer rim is generated by using rotate_extrude() on a translated circle primitive, matching the thickness and outer radius of the main body.
